Feel the call even when the app is closed
Allow location “All the time” and Campus Quest will alert you when you get close to the next place, even with the app closed. You can still play without it.

Campus Quest uses your location to guide you to each checkpoint, show your position on the map and confirm when you have reached a place. Without it, the map cannot show where you are, distance guidance will not appear and checkpoints cannot be discovered. The game will not work properly.
Settings → Apps → Campus Quest → Permissions → Location → “Allow only while using the app”, and switch on “Use precise location”.
The camera is used to scan the repair card in the Light the Way quest. Without it, the card step cannot be completed and the quest cannot be finished.
Settings → Apps → Campus Quest → Permissions → Camera → “Allow only while using the app”.
Notifications tell you when you are near the next checkpoint and when new quests are published. Without them you will not receive these alerts. The game itself will still work.
Settings → Apps → Campus Quest → Notifications → “Allow notifications”.
Background location lets Campus Quest alert you when you approach the next checkpoint while the app is closed. Without it these alerts will not appear. Guidance inside the app will still work.
Settings → Apps → Campus Quest → Permissions → Location → “Allow all the time”.
